title: Keyed Lookup State
summary: Store per-key metadata such as a count, earliest index, latest index, or accumulated value so later work can reuse it directly.
recognition_signals: the output depends on frequency or position
the same key may appear many times
later items need metadata about earlier occurrences
core_rules: Choose the smallest per-key value that future steps actually need.
Update metadata without discarding distinctions that the output contract still requires.
structural_steps: choose the metadata stored for that key
read existing metadata when processing an item
update the key's metadata for future items

common_confusions.distinction: A set answers only whether a key exists. A lookup map is needed when the value associated with the key matters.
